title: Kimi and Gemini visual infrastructure cohort
description: Kimi K3, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B each received three attempts at a topology-drift incident where the production diagram was authoritative evidence.
observations: Kimi K3 and Gemini 3.7 Flash each completed three of three durable repairs.
Kimi K3 posted the faster median at 1:41; Gemini 3.7 Flash recorded a 2:28 median.
Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B produced no meaningful inference because its available endpoint rejected image input, so all three attempts remain unavailable rather than failed.
notes: This is a visual-input cohort. The prompt did not translate the authoritative topology diagram into text.
Unavailable Qwen attempts are retained for endpoint-capability audit and excluded from pass rates.
reproduction_command: python integrations/host/run_host_matrix.py --scenario-pack ../replaybook-infra --scenario 029-visual-topology-drift --models moonshotai/kimi-k3 google/gemini-3.7-flash qwen/qwen3.8-2.4t-a95b --reasoning-efforts high --attempts 3 --concurrency 2 --base-port 28600 --claux-binary ../claux/target/release/claux
